name: header_inference
method: tables with 0 detected header rows: leading rows with text beyond the first column and no number except years become header rows (at most 4), only if a row with numbers follows. Sample drawn with random.Random(seed).sample.
rule_version: v2: a row whose only text beyond column 1 repeats the first cell (a span) is a section, not a header. Fresh sample (seed 43) after the fix.

visual_review.method: PDF region vs grid, number of header rows judged by eye (header text quality not judged here)
